context7.description: Up-to-date library and framework documentation lookup

playwright.description: Browser automation and E2E verification via Playwright

deja-vu.description: Opt-in offline recall over local coding-session transcripts

atlassian.description: Jira & Confluence integration (pinned uvx package, placeholder credentials)

parallel-search.description: Parallel Web Search — LLM-optimized web_search and web_fetch tools that take an objective + queries and return citation-backed excerpts in a single call (replaces multiple keyword searches). Works key-free for anonymous use. For higher rate limits, add a headers block: { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_PARALLEL_API_KEY_HERE" } using a key from platform.parallel.ai.

arcmira.description: YouTube transcript search and monitoring for your AI: exact quotes, full transcripts and speakers. Needs an Arcmira API key, or drop the headers block on hosts that sign in with MCP OAuth.

memxus.description: Universal persistent memory across Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and any AI tool — save context once, auto-recalled in every session. Note: review stored memories before use in production agents to avoid prompt-injection via memory-poisoning. Free at memxus.com

browser-use.description: AI browser agent for web tasks

devfleet.description: Multi-agent orchestration — dispatch parallel Claude Code agents in isolated worktrees. Plan projects, auto-chain missions, read structured reports. Repo: https://github.com/LEC-AI/claude-devfleet

laraplugins.description: Laravel plugin discovery — search packages by keyword, health score, Laravel/PHP version compatibility. Use with laravel-plugin-discovery skill.

mnemosyne-os.description: Opt-in Mnemosyne OS desktop-app memory and dashboard. Replace MNEMO_VAULTS with approved vault names before enabling; the app ingests selected folders into persistent vaults, and memory_ingest can save content for later agents. Vault scope does not restrict session tools, which read local coding-agent transcripts. Review folder and transcript access before enabling. Memory tools use the app at ws://127.0.0.1:7799. Tool results, including private memory and session data, go to the MCP client and its model provider. Version 2.4.0 adds mnemosyne_telegram_send, which uploads a local media or PDF file to the Telegram chat configured in the app, and on macOS mnemosyne_mac_update_install, which downloads the latest GitHub release and replaces the installed app; require client approval for both, or deny them if unused. Not enabled by default.

_comments.usage: Copy only the servers you need into your local ~/.claude.json, ~/.cursor/mcp.json, or ~/.codex/config.toml
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with actual values (never commit real secrets)
_comments.pinning: All npx and uvx servers are pinned to explicit reviewed versions (no @latest)
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled to preserve context window
